log.en: But it's such a good point about even if you think you're not consciously logging the stuff that you're doing, there is some that's in the back of your mind was it the daemon is that what the ancient greeks are something used to talk about yeah also in computer science like there's a concept of a daemon which is a uh a program that's always running in the background you can't see it okay um but yeah it probably comes from the ancient greek daemon uh but yeah what you know that you don't even know you know is far greater than what you know you know right you can't even articulate most of the things you know.
log.zh: 但这真是一个极好的观点，哪怕你觉得自己并没有在有意识地记录你所做的事情，但你的脑海深处确实留存着一些东西，这就是所谓的“守护灵”吗？古希腊人以前常常谈论的东西吗？对的，在计算机科学里也有“守护灵”（daemon）这个概念，也就是一个总是在后台运行、你看不见的程序，对吧，不过是的，它大概源自古希腊语中的 daemon 吧，但你知道的、甚至连自己都不知道你所知道的东西，要远远多于你知道自己知道的东西，对吧？你甚至无法表述你所知道的大多数事情。
